window_convention: a window starting on day s runs to the same calendar date one year later, both ends inclusive (template/prelude_template.py, WINDOW_OFFSET = pd.DateOffset(years=1)); 366 days unless the span contains no 29 February

development.used_for: choosing between configurations (the development selection metric)

embargo.used_for: nothing; separates development from hold-out because consecutive windows share up to 365 days

hold_out.used_for: scored once per round winner for the record, never used to choose

note_on_committed_window_tables: output/spd_tables/final_*, uniform_*, tournament_* and upstream_* were written at the 22 August 2026 close (2,791 windows on B) and 'final' there is candidate v1; robust_v5_* are the final model at the 24 August close; the benchmark tables at the 24 August close are regenerated by this script
